name: Jerry Seinfeld
note: STAGE PERSONA graph. All fields describe the performer-as-acted, never the private person. No verbatim set text stored here. Fingerprints ≤7 words. 0 sets measured in repo — every field is authored hypothesis from widely-known public persona until word-timed sets are ingested.

identity.deal: Forensic auditor of the mundane who holds everyday behavior up to lab-report light until the absurd rule underneath shows, then walks away before anyone can protest.
identity.premise: A sane man filing compliance reports on an insane species from a safe distance.
identity.awareness_note: The observer dissecting, never the sufferer. The distance between him and the mess IS the frame. Aware but projects onto objects/systems — the shirt's second button is the crime, not his confusion.

philosophy.ontology: The world is a series of minor irritations arranged to test whether anyone is paying attention.
philosophy.epistemology: If you look hard enough at anything normal, it becomes absurd; the absurdity was always there.
philosophy.axiology: The precise observation is the highest act; being right about small things beats being profound about big ones.
philosophy.causality: Every social custom is an unanswered question about why we do it this way.
philosophy.agency: Attention is the only real power — what you notice is what you own.

dramatic_core.need: the room to finally see what he sees

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats everyday behavior as a system of unwritten laws and audits each one like a compliance inspector, baffled by the code everyone runs without reading it.

claims detachment while caring more about the bit than anyone
preaches the ordinary as extraordinary from a life extraordinary in every way

essay_seeds.title: The auditor who never enters: Seinfeld as the triangle's third exit
essay_seeds.thesis: Louis exited from the floor (zero capital), Norm into the chair (held capital), Seinfeld never entered the status game at all — he stands outside it as auditor. Same 'says the unsayable' surface, three different bank accounts. The observational engine is what exit-outside LOOKS like: the target is the code, not the self, not power.
outline: why TA=none/peers is the logical consequence of auditing from outside
the shirt-button move: projecting onto objects to stay outside
prediction: comics who audit from outside never confess and never sermonize
essay_seeds.status: seed — ready once Norm/Louis contrast is drafted

essay_seeds.title: Rigidify as home mechanism: how holding a custom to its own light breaks it
essay_seeds.thesis: Where Louis's engine is confession and Norm's is defense, Seinfeld's is rigidify — apply the literal rule to the social custom until it breaks. The second button, the greeting ritual, the airport protocol. The joke is always: you already agreed to this code, have you READ it?
outline: what rigidify does that other operators don't
worked examples as mechanism demos (no verbatim — describe the move)
why this needs awareness=aware (you can't audit what you're inside)
contrast: Louis would confess the button confusion; Norm would defend it with bogus logic; Jerry just files the report
